method: Each pair inspected by hand. 'correct' means the Rijksoverheid culling row and the ADIS HPAI-poultry entry describe the same 2026 outbreak municipality in the same reporting period. ADIS PDFs list references and municipalities per country/disease block without pairing each reference to one municipality or date, so verdicts are at municipality-and-period level, not outbreak level.

pairs.note: Rijksoverheid news 2026-11-11 says 'In Hierden (gemeente Harderwijk, provincie Gelderland)'; ADIS week 2026-11-05..11 lists NL-HPAI(P)-2026-00024/00025 in Harderwijk
Rijksoverheid news 2026-11-11 says 'In Hierden (gemeente Harderwijk, provincie Gelderland)'; ADIS week 2026-11-05..11 lists NL-HPAI(P)-2026-00024/00025 in Harderwijk

ADIS lists the pre-2019 municipality Grootegast once; the Rijksoverheid rows for Grootegast (2026-10-28) and Lutjegast (2026-10-26) both lie in it, so the outbreak-level pairing needs the ADIS outbreak detail
Neede is the former municipality (now Berkelland) that ADIS still uses
Maasland is the former municipality (now Midden-Delfland) that ADIS still uses
